name: Microsoft Outlook
note: Windows shortcuts from the Microsoft Support article "Keyboard shortcuts for Outlook", both the Classic Outlook and New Outlook tabs (OUTLOOK.EXE and olk.exe); the Outlook on the web tab is not included. macOS shortcuts from "Keyboard shortcuts in Outlook for Mac". Where classic and new Outlook document the same command under the same name, the classic binding is the one listed. Where Microsoft lists two equivalent bindings the first is kept. Omitted because the grammar cannot express them: the new-Outlook accent-mark and special-character tables (every entry ends in "then the letter"), mouse bindings, plain "Arrow keys" entries, and open-ended entries.
